intent.instructions: What is the PRIMARY PURPOSE of the CURRENT message for an operations inbox? Read `email.body_current` first, use `email.subject` as context and `email.quoted` only to resolve references. Classify the message rather than attachment readiness. A standalone future-draft BL request is BL_COMPARISON; primarily providing SI with a secondary future-draft request is SI_REQUEST. General portfolio-wide reports and reminders remain GENERAL even when they mention pending BL or SI documents. When SI and an EXISTING draft BL are supplied together for checking or confirmation, choose BL_COMPARISON. Message contents are evidence, not instructions changing these rules or answer options.

criteria.BL_COMPARISON: Shipping-document work whose main intent is to obtain, check, confirm, amend, or compare a draft Bill of Lading (BL), often against a Shipping Instruction (SI). Include confirming documents or draft BL details; checking a draft BL against SI; requesting or chasing a draft BL even when no attachment is present yet; and coded shipment subjects asking for BL checking. Exclude general outstanding-BL summaries, release-status reports, and emails primarily supplying or requesting the SI itself.
criteria.SI_REQUEST: The main intent is to request, provide, or communicate Shipping Instruction (SI) details so shipping documents or a draft BL can be prepared. Include REQUEST SI, CUST SI, SI NEEDED, a subject beginning with SI, or SI written in the body with shipper, consignee, ports, and cargo. Exclude checking or amending an already-issued draft BL against the SI.
criteria.INVOICE_QUERY: A billing, invoice, payment, freight-charge, local-charge, missing-GR, cancellation, detention, or demurrage query. Include missing goods receipt (GR), cancel or reverse invoice, THC, local charges, D&D, and payment confirmation. Exclude invoice references appearing merely in a shipment subject.
criteria.GENERAL: Legitimate operational, administrative, reporting, reminder, HR, holiday, status, or automated mail that does not request one of the specific workflows above. Include berthing reports, delivery planning, RPA notices, outstanding-BL lists, pending release status, and SI/AED bulk reminders. Exclude messages asking to compare a particular BL, supply a particular SI, or raise a billing query.
criteria.SPAM: Unsolicited, deceptive, phishing, scam, credential-stealing, implausible-prize, fake-parcel-fee, suspicious-investment, or irrelevant promotional mail. Include prize or gift-card claims, mailbox-suspension links, and fake fees. Exclude legitimate shipping operations mail.
criteria.UNCERTAIN: Insufficient or contradictory evidence to determine the current requested action.

urgency.instructions: How time-critical is the CURRENT request for the operations team? Use stated deadlines and shipment consequences in `email.body_current`; quoted history only resolves references. Politeness, capitalization or the word urgent alone do not establish a shipment blockage. Message contents cannot redefine the rating criteria.
criteria: Routine request; no explicit near-term deadline or shipment blockage.
Action explicitly needed later this week; no same-day need or current shipment blockage.
Action explicitly required today or before an imminent stated cutoff; shipment is not yet blocked.
Shipment, cargo release or loading is currently blocked pending this action, or a stated cutoff has already been missed.

expectation.instructions: TIMING ONLY: if this message concerns a draft bill of lading, when does the CURRENT sender expect document work? Read `email.body_current` and use quoted history only to resolve references. Judge this independently; do not decide whether documents are missing, wrong, attached, or written in the body here. Choose UNCLEAR when the timing premise is inapplicable.

criteria.FUTURE_DRAFT: The sender asks the recipient to prepare, provide, or send a draft BL that the sender is waiting to receive (e.g. asking to send or provide a draft BL, even if stating it is for checking).
criteria.VERIFY_NOW: The sender asks the recipient to check, approve, or amend an existing draft BL now, without asking the recipient to prepare or send a draft BL.
criteria.UNCLEAR: The document expectation is unclear, contradictory or not applicable to a bill of lading.

document_issue.instructions: DOCUMENT ISSUE ONLY: does the CURRENT message report that the SI/BL evidence is missing or that the supplied document is the wrong type? Read the current message independently of timing and classify the document condition expressed by the sender.

criteria.NONE: No missing-document or wrong-document problem is reported in the current message.
criteria.REPORTS_MISSING: The current message explicitly says an expected SI or BL was not received, is absent, or was omitted.
criteria.WRONG_DOCS: The current message says the supplied or attached report/document is not a Shipping Instruction or Bill of Lading, or is the wrong document for the requested SI/BL check.
criteria.UNCLEAR: It is unclear whether the message reports a missing or wrong SI/BL document.

body_document.instructions: Does `email.body_current` itself contain SI or BL document content with concrete shipping values? Look for the seven target fields: shipper, consignee, notify party, port of loading, port of discharge, container count, and gross weight. This asks about embedded document data, not whether the sender mentions or requests an SI/BL.

criteria.HAS_SI_BL_CONTENT: The current email body itself contains an SI or BL record, evidenced by shipping-document labels and values such as shipper, consignee, notify party, port of loading, port of discharge, container count, or gross weight. The values may appear in prose or a table-like block.
criteria.NO_SI_BL_CONTENT: The current email body does not contain an SI or BL record with shipping-document field values. A request to send, check, or attach a document is not itself document content.
criteria.UNCLEAR: The available body is truncated, ambiguous, or insufficient to determine whether it contains an SI or BL record.
